body: I guess one solution would be to exclude the core test suite from the pear packages?

Composer has [an option to influence the classmap](http://getcomposer.org/doc/04-schema.md#classmap) though I don't know if it's possible to influence that with the pear install (?).

Unless there's a simple way to have the test files and exclude them - I'm :+1: on removing the Test files from the pear package (we'd still need the test _suite_ to run app/plugin tests).

> we'd still need the test suite to run app/plugin tests

I don't understand this.

"I guess one solution would be to exclude the core test suite"

Perhaps it's just wording - the core test cases cause the problems but the [test _suite_](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/tree/master/lib/Cake/TestSuite) is required to run any test cases.
that folder will remain, we just need to exclude the core Tests
My mistake. The pear package would exclude `lib/Cake/Test/Case` from future packages.

Might be better to drop the whole Test folder othewise there will likely be some circumstance whereby users find they are loading [from the test_app](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/master/lib/Cake/Test/test_app/Controller/AppController.php) instead of their own app's files such as happened for [this user here](http://stackoverflow.com/q/20952732/761202). Though that will _also_ mean that user-land tests can't rely on anything from the core (such as core fixtures).

If there are no duplicate class declarations, the autoload-shuffle becomes unnecessary too.
Good point. I'll update the build scripts to do that.

I am the user from the StackOverflow issue, I just tried to bake some controllers however I hit a few issues again with CakePHP looking at the wrong place for fixtures and getting confused (one of my models has the same name as one of the test fixtures within `/lib/Cake/Test/Fixture`) - I read through this thread so tried just removing `lib/Cake/Test` to see if that would resolve my problem. Removing it causes further issues where Cake is looking for files within that folder. I have uploaded the errors to pastebin: http://pastebin.com/raw.php?i=TqhfW6r7 so you can see the issue. 

Sorry if this isn't the best place to bring this up or if the files that is being referred to in my pastebin would remain, just wanted to be sure that the above had been considered.
Hi @pummra Once you remove those directories you'll need to regenerate your autoloader.

Thanks @markstory that helps, although with the folder removed the autoloader regenerated and `cake bake controller all` doesn't do any thing

http://pastebin.com/raw.php?i=ikFWjqSf

It is still possible to bake each controller manually however. Will see if I can debug what the issue is.

`cake bake controller all` works after I have baked all of the models, before the models have been created line 117 of https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/master/lib/Cake/Console/Command/Task/ControllerTask.php always returns false.
@pummra can you paste your `bootstrap.php`? Seems like the CakePHP autoloader isn't being loaded...

I think the last problem here is just a misunderstanding.

> `cake bake controller all` works after I have baked all of the models

"cake bake _controller_ all" only bakes controllers for models that exist. If there are no models, there are no controllers to bake. 

Skimming the code right now - it aught to be looping on models, not tables. The way it works probably adds to the confusion.
Ah, my fault sorry guys! I have submitted a pull request for ControllerTask.php to throw a message if no Controllers are baked, hope its helpful.
